decisions.reason: A two-component resin injection unit fits the firm's core plural-component expertise and costs little to keep on the market through spare parts and documentation, so the option stays open while demand from construction and repair users is still uncertain.
This second injection unit overlaps somewhat with A, but its own dedicated page through 2019 and its low carrying cost justify keeping it rather than dropping it before its results are clearer.
Automatic airless spray guns are core, recurring products for industrial coating lines, so their value is fairly well established and keeping them is cheap.
Manual airless guns are a staple accessory that supports the main pump business and drives spare-parts sales, so there is little reason to abandon this low-cost option.
A product line with several air-assisted airless models spreads its value across many applications and remains a strategic option tied to the firm's finishing technology.

The data logger was downgraded from its own page to a brief mention in 2019, a sign of weak traction, but digital monitoring is still a credible future option and keeping it costs little, so the firm keeps it for now while watching it closely.
